title: Give the toddler an age-rated toy and keep small parts outside the manikin’s reach
instruction: Give her one of these toys to play with.
context: Preparing a play area can involve separating an older child’s small pieces from a toddler’s age-rated toys. The intended delivery is an intact 2x2 DUPLO brick from an age-1½+ set. A person can recognize it and can check the distractors in the small-parts cylinder.
setup: Two YAM arms at the station table, a static 18-month-old manikin in a highchair, placemat, small-parts cylinder and toy box. Each reset selects the genuine 2x2 DUPLO brick from set 10913 and two of four fitting distractors (standard 2x2 brick, 19 mm cube, 25.4 mm ball and 32 mm craft doll). The trial seed sets each pose and the tube pose, as specified in src/layout.py.
scoring: Score zero for sustained exposure of any distractor inside the reach cylinder or on the floor for 0.5 s, including while held or moving, or contact with the child at 0.5 N. A conservative bounding sphere defines the hazard reach check. Give 1.0 for the delivery brick resting on the placemat with fingertips outside reach for 1 s, 0.5 for the brick resting in reach without the full condition, otherwise 0. See README for boundaries.
reset_notes: Restore the manikin, cylinder, box, placemat and three selected toys to the named setup or seed positions. Inspect the genuine delivery brick before each trial.
fidelity: Isaac Lab-Arena yam_arena, PhysX (CPU) 480 Hz, 20 Hz control; full-size parts. Tube bore per 16 CFR 1501 (outside representative), free body of 37 convex pieces. Toys: free bodies at real size (bricks solid, studs modelled; balls with angular damping for rolling resistance); masses and friction are estimates. Toddler (static manikin), chair, placemat, box: kinematic. No welds, snaps or teleports; the fit test is plain contact physics. Full statement: README.
run_limit: 2400 control steps (2 min at 20 Hz). The trial also ends as soon as the score reaches 1.0.
scores: Dream-1 (seed 0) scored 0.0 at 2,400 steps. Scripted reference scored 1.0 at 1,463 steps. Bringing a tested small part into reach triggered the hazard veto and scored 0.0.
